name: Esashi (Sōya, Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Esashi town emblem in green and blue: a lozenge divided green and blue bearing a white wave and a stylised sail.
history: Municipal flag of Esashi, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 March 2006.

features.role: Esashi town emblem — a lozenge divided green and blue bearing a white wave and a stylised sail
